arities_from.op/EC_SCALAR_MUL: stated: two points / a scalar and a point

limits: found by the decidability test on generated objects; the arities of EC_ADD, EC_SCALAR_MUL and BIT_NOR are stated, the others read from the op cards' Python forms
name: W5_arity_gaps

provenance.source: The Gödel Method: Research and Development Handover (2026-10-22), W-5

statement: Two numberings were not admissible as stored: the machines set's effects carried an optional guard and no fixed argument count, and the computation set's 13 atoms are not IR ops, so nothing stated their arities; their codes could not be parsed back (Rule-2). Each set card now states its arities (op/BIT_NAND from its Python form, op/BIT_NOR from stated: NOR of two words (its Python form names a library function), op/CONST_MUL from its Python form, ...), and an effect's guard slot holds logic/true when it always happens.
